home.title: 豆豆龙 · 推开故事的门
home.prompt: A warm playful instrumental welcome theme for a children's storybook English learning app. Cheerful wooden marimba melody, soft ukulele strumming, pizzicato strings, gentle hand percussion, rounded acoustic bass. Cozy magical library, curious little dragon, sunny and friendly. Simple memorable melody, gentle dynamics, clean studio sound. Instrumental only, no vocals. 100 BPM, C major.

journey.title: 西游记 · 小小悟空向前走
journey.prompt: An original cheerful Mandarin children's adventure song about a little Monkey King travelling with friends, for ages 5 to 9. Clear sweet female lead vocal, friendly natural singing, simple catchy pentatonic melody, playful bamboo flute, plucked pipa, warm acoustic guitar, light woodblocks and soft hand drums. Sunny, brave, kind and magical, never scary. Easy to sing along, clear Mandarin diction, brief instrumental intro and a complete gentle ending. 108 BPM, D major, polished children's animation opening song.
journey.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
小小悟空眨眨眼
白云变成小飞船
金箍棒呀转个圈
好朋友就在身边
[Chorus]
向前走 向前走
大手拉着小小手
翻过山 看彩虹
勇敢的心亮晶晶
[Verse]
遇到难题想一想
学会一句大声讲
帮助朋友笑一笑
今天又比昨天棒
[Chorus]
向前走 向前走
大手拉着小小手
翻过山 看彩虹
勇敢的心亮晶晶
[Outro]
好朋友 一起走

blocks.title: 我的世界 · 方块小小建筑家
blocks.prompt: Original playful instrumental music for young children exploring and building a colorful block world. Gentle plucky 8-bit synth arpeggios blended with warm marimba, soft acoustic guitar, airy flute, round bass and delicate shaker. A curious little builder placing blocks, growing trees and sharing a sunny house with friends. Friendly, cozy, imaginative, bouncy but relaxed. Memorable simple melody, soft transients, no harsh electronic leads, no vocals. 96 BPM, G major, clean spacious game soundtrack with a satisfying ending.

journey-soft.title: 西游记 · 云朵陪你慢慢走
journey-soft.prompt: Tender lyrical Mandarin song for young children. Warm gentle female singing, slow spacious pentatonic melody with long held notes, soft piano, delicate bamboo flute, warm acoustic guitar, airy strings. Dreamy, comforting, heartfelt storybook atmosphere. Very sparse vocals, generous instrumental breathing space between short phrases, 6 second instrumental intro and long gentle outro. Soft dynamics, minimal percussion, no driving beat, no fast syllables. 84 BPM, D major.
journey-soft.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
白云飘呀飘
小手摇呀摇
[Instrumental]
[Chorus]
小悟空 慢慢走
好朋友 拉拉手
山那边 有彩虹
我们一起 慢慢走
[Outro]
